def unique_jobs(rows):
    seen = set()
    out = []
    for r in rows:
        sid = r.get('source_id')
        if sid is None or sid == '':
            out.append(r)
            continue
        key = (r.get('source'), sid)
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        out.append(r)
    return out
